verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The sage circle has come loose from the can and drifts in the bottom-left, where it collides with the CTA row. The SOLSTICE wordmark has dropped below the headline. 'back' sits alone on the second headline line. The CTA has shrunk to a badge-sized pill crammed into a jumbled row with the two badges, so it no longer stands out. A is slightly less bad: its can is bigger and its CTA is more legible, though the CTA nearly touches the 'Back by demand' badge, which runs close to the right edge. B shrinks everything further (tiny CTA and body text, small can) and leaves large dead areas above and below.
